standard_prerequisites: Lemma lemma-equivalent-with-artin part (6): for a presentation B = A[x_1,...,x_r]^/J over (A, I) it produces c >= 0 and f_1,...,f_r in J such that the Jacobian determinant det(d f_j / d x_i) divides a^c in B and a^c J is contained in (f_1,...,f_r) + J^2
Lemma lemma-approximate-presentation-rig-smooth (delivered, L48002): converts precisely such presentation data into a finite type A-algebra C with B isomorphic to C^
core_obligations: Let A be a Noetherian ring and I = (a) a principal ideal. Every rig-etale object B of the category (equation-C-prime) over (A, I) is isomorphic to C^ for some finite type A-algebra C.
proof_roadmap: Apply lemma-equivalent-with-artin part (6) to obtain c >= 0 and f_1,...,f_r in J with the Jacobian divisibility det(...) | a^c and the inclusion a^c J in (f_1,...,f_r) + J^2, both displayed in the proof.

Invoke lemma-approximate-presentation-rig-smooth on that data; it finishes the proof. The author adds that the general lemma get-morphism-general-better could be replaced by the easier get-morphism-principal here.
difficulty_reason: H2: a two-step citation argument in which the first cited lemma is applied with its full output data displayed (Jacobian divisibility and ideal inclusion), and the second converts the data to the conclusion; both carrying lemmas are proved in the same chapter.
